title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 10: the Assyrian as the rod of God's anger, his proud boasting, and the remnant that will return.

questions.text: On whom is the first woe of this chapter pronounced?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens, "Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees."

questions.text: What do the writers of oppressive decrees make of widows and the fatherless?
questions.explanation: They rob the poor of their rights, "that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey."

questions.text: What does Yahweh call the Assyrian in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!"

questions.text: What is in the heart of the Assyrian, though God sends him with a command?
questions.explanation: The text says, "However he doesn't mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations."

answers.text: To return home with the plunder
To destroy and cut off not a few nations

questions.text: Whom will the Lord punish when He has performed His whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The Lord will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

questions.text: What question does the text ask about the ax?
questions.explanation: The text asks, "Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it?"

answers.text: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it?
Can an ax cut down a whole forest?
Who sharpens the ax for battle?
Can an ax be trusted in unskilled hands?

questions.text: How few will the remnant of the trees of the Assyrian's forest be?
questions.explanation: The text says the remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

answers.text: Not one will be left standing
They will fill only one valley
So few that a child could write their number

questions.text: To whom will the remnant of Jacob return?
questions.explanation: The text says, "A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God."

answers.text: To the land of their fathers

questions.text: Yahweh's scourge against the Assyrian is compared to the slaughter of Midian at which rock?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb.

questions.text: Where will the invader halt on the very day he shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion?
questions.explanation: The text says, "This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem."
